headline: The lieutenant now walks to his steel
lede: DOUBLE DRAGON's stage-2 duel fights the arcade's way: a thrown knife is spent steel, and whoever reaches it first owns it — the boss fetches his, or you deny him and take his belt's only knife off the asphalt.

notes.text: #2948 shipped (b1aeaa8): cast spends the blade for the duel AND the yard casters; retrieval walks the honest gait (props solid, stuck-beat honoured); an unarmed thrower never re-aims — denial is now a tactic, not luck. 7 new laws pinned, retrieval-dead mutant named red, winnable re-measured 12/12 + co-op 6/6.

Two lanes double-shot the whip/stick gap today: slot b's #2945 branch was closed without merge when #2946 shipped it first (per-issue claim locks missed the cross-issue collision; noted for the platform log). Nothing shipped twice.

heistclock-style advisory flakes continue on pre-existing browser legs (#2891 grace-boundary, #2897 settle-bar, #2889 tag ink flip between runs of identical code). Single required gate `static` stayed green all day; nothing merge-blocking.
